problem: A frozen Array<Symbol> constant declared in another file was treated as a namespace receiver during cold project indexing, producing a false unresolved-method error on each and losing block types when unchanged files opened.
changes: Seed direct value-constant symbols and types before cold body inference; preserve the existing applicability policy for extension namespace skeletons.
Retain exact Unknown constant facts for deferred aliases rather than guessing class-object types from unresolved syntax.
Persist proven block-owned local reads alongside flow deltas, and never substitute scope zero in local-variable hover.
Use a conservative source prefilter and a reusable Prism declaration probe; avoid semantic context preparation and empty replacement/resolve work for files without value constants.

coverage: symbol-to-string declaration edit, restoration, and close/reopen

performance.scope: Built-in neutral profiler corpus; five alternating pairs, 100 samples per editor operation. Absolute budget validation only; not representative-project relative-performance or native-editor release acceptance.

limitations: The whole workspace is not green: the pre-existing delayed-diagnostics regression remains deliberately failing.
The three existing scale/corpus deferrals were not enabled by this focused fix.
These are neutral local measurements, not representative two-project JRuby, native editor, or beta release acceptance.
The baseline identity is the retained executable hash; profiler runtime checkout metadata must not be interpreted as the source identity of that older executable.
